items.title: Breakout entry-threshold study
items.excerpt: Across 2015-2024 equities, entry thresholds between 0.8σ and 1.0σ dominate on net Sharpe after costs; sub-0.8σ degrades to noise trading.

items.title: Overnight drift decay — literature notes
items.excerpt: Post gap-up drift decay is strongest within two sessions; falsification tests should condition on gap size and prior-day volume.

items.title: Term-structure carry primer (external)
items.excerpt: Roll yield dominates P&L for calendar-spread carry strategies when the term structure is in backwardation.
